narrative.details:
The only thing that remains of this human are some charred bones. He seems to have died within arms reach of what he was after - unfired plate gauntlets.

Perhaps you should grab the gauntlets and get out of the fire?
narrative.objectives: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!
